content.value_statement: Teams often create video ads with the wrong dimensions, duration, captions, or safe zones for each platform. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a platform-specific guide for planning video ads and generating CLI-ready creative prompts.
actual_capabilities: Provides platform specs for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, YouTube, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn.
Explains aspect ratios, resolution targets, duration norms, sound behavior, and safe zones from the skill guide.
Maps video ad structure to the AIDA framework with timing guidance for each stage.
Offers hook techniques, caption rules, and common mistake checks for mobile video ads.
Includes belt CLI examples for video generation, voiceover, audio merging, and burned-in captions.
Supplies reusable ad structure templates for testimonial, demo, and before-after formats.
limitations: Generation examples require the inference.sh belt CLI, account access, and any needed model permissions.
Platform specifications can change, so final ads should be checked against each platform before launch.
The skill does not replace brand, legal, accessibility, or advertising policy review.
It does not create final media unless the required CLI, source assets, and credentials are available.

use_cases.title: Prepare Social Ad Concepts
use_cases.description: Plan TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, Facebook, or LinkedIn ad concepts with the correct format before production starts.

use_cases.title: Translate Briefs Into Production Prompts
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into scene prompts, voiceover direction, caption needs, and platform-specific delivery requirements.

use_cases.title: Review Video Ad Readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether an ad concept has the right hook, duration, captions, CTA timing, and safe-zone treatment.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Platform Specs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the video-ad-specs skill to list the recommended format, duration, caption needs, and safe zones for a [platform] ad about [product].

prompt_templates.title: Draft AIDA Video Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to create a 15 to 30 second AIDA outline for [product] targeting [audience] on [platform]. Include hook, product reveal, proof, and CTA timing.

prompt_templates.title: Build Production Prompts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to convert this brief into video scene prompts, voiceover copy, caption guidance, and platform specs: [brief]. Keep each scene matched to [platform].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Multi-Platform Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to review these ad concepts for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Flag mismatched ratios, weak hooks, missing captions, unsafe text placement, and CTA timing problems: [concepts].

output_examples.input: Plan a 15 second TikTok ad for a desk organizer.
output_examples.output: The response outlines a vertical 9:16 concept with a one-second hook, a messy-desk problem scene, a clean reveal, captions, and a final link-in-bio CTA.

output_examples.input: Adapt one software demo ad for YouTube and LinkedIn.
output_examples.output: The response separates a six-second YouTube bumper from a professional LinkedIn feed version, with different aspect ratios, pacing, and CTA placement.

output_examples.input: Check this video ad script before launch.
output_examples.output: The response flags late branding, missing captions, platform duration risk, unsafe bottom text placement, and unclear final action.

best_practices: Name the target platform before asking for specs or production guidance.
Provide the product, audience, offer, proof point, and desired CTA in the prompt.
Verify final dimensions, duration, captions, and policy requirements in the ad platform before publishing.
anti_patterns: Using one landscape video for every social platform without resizing or restructuring it.
Skipping captions because the ad includes voiceover or music.
Requesting final launch approval without checking platform rules, claims, rights, and brand standards.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, YouTube, Facebook Feed, and LinkedIn video ad formats.

faq.question: Can it generate video files directly?
faq.answer: It provides belt CLI examples for generation workflows, but actual file creation requires the CLI, credentials, and service access.

faq.question: Does it help with captions?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains why captions matter and includes guidance for readable, high-contrast captions on mobile video.

faq.question: Can I use it for paid media production?
faq.answer: Yes. It is useful for planning paid social creative, briefing production, and checking platform-specific requirements.

faq.question: Are the platform specs guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides the included guide content, but platforms can change specs and policies after publication.

faq.question: Does it replace legal or platform policy review?
faq.answer: No. Use it for creative and technical planning, then verify claims, rights, targeting, and platform policy compliance separately.
